prompt:
The section sections/event-listing-escaped.liquid renders a list of events. Its markup escapes every text setting and outputs the event link as an href attribute. The markup is already correct, so do not change it. Only the {% schema %} JSON is wrong: the heading uses the wrong setting type, block settings are missing or have the wrong type, and there are no limits or presets.

Replace the schema JSON so that it is exactly the following, with keys in this order:

1. "name": "Event listing"
2. "tag": "section"
3. "class": "section-event-listing"
4. "settings": one entry: {"type": "text", "id": "heading", "label": "Heading", "default": <the literal text Events & "Pop-ups">}. The default must be plain text: a raw ampersand and real double-quote characters, JSON-escaped as needed. It must not contain HTML entities, because the markup escapes it at render time.
5. "blocks": one block type {"type": "event", "name": "Event", "settings": [...]}. Its settings are, in this order:
   - {"type": "text", "id": "title", "label": "Event title", "default": "Makers' Market"}
   - {"type": "text", "id": "date_label", "label": "Date", "default": "May 4 & 5"}
   - {"type": "url", "id": "link", "label": "Event link"} with no default
   - {"type": "text", "id": "link_label", "label": "Link label", "default": "Get tickets"}
6. "max_blocks": 12 (an integer)
7. "presets": [{"name": "Event listing", "blocks": [{"type": "event"}, {"type": "event"}]}]

Do not add any other keys, for example no "info" and no "limit". The file must keep exactly one top-level schema block. Change only sections/event-listing-escaped.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
